title: Pack Commands
description: a utility mod for storing and reusing commands
body:
Pack Commands adds a new Stored Commands screen that allows the player to store and access used commands from any world and game session; as well as a few brand new commands to improve QoL.

New Commands:
- /variant -- with four branches
  - display -- summon display entities of every mob variant
  - set -- change the variant of a selected mob
  - list -- list registered mob variants
  - summon -- summon a mob as a specified variant
- /dropEggs -- force chickens to drop eggs
- /ageUp -- age up all baby mobs
